title: A pack on a host that cannot reach a source's provider gives up fast instead of spending the revalidation budget on every pack
goal: Retrospective of SP-etslk6yu (worker of ST-jqwqdj2g): kb_pack and kb_ask.py now revalidate stale sources by default, up to factdiff.REVALIDATE_BUDGET_S (90 s); on a firewalled host that drops packets, each request waits for its timeout and every pack can spend the whole budget. After a provider host fails to connect once, the lookups of that process (and of later processes within a bounded window, recorded under _cache/) mark its sources offline with no request; a test stubs a connect timeout and finds the second pack makes no request to that host.
